title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theatre on 1984-07-03
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-1 > Mytek Digital 8x96 ADC > Steinberg Nuendo (Waves Q10) > Waves L2 Ultramaximizer
source: Nak CM100 shotgun mics > Sony TCD5M (lead deck) > Dolby B noise reduction > MAC (Maxell MX 90 Metal tape)

ai_review.summary: Well‑balanced recording showcases a tight Scarlet > Touch > Fire transition and an epic 11‑minute Deal.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the overall mix, noting clear top‑end detail while still giving Phil's bass presence its due. Musically the show shines with a “Nice Scarlet > Touch > Fire” sequence and a standout, extended Deal that they call epic.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 4‑star review highlights strong performance and good sound balance, yielding a solid rating but limited data for higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear top end, excellent overall balance, bass (Phil) well represented; no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive flow highlighted by a smooth Scarlet‑Touch‑Fire segue and an extended, epic Deal that energizes the set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is present and balanced; not lacking in Phil either.
